417002028e511228b84b3895c427db4c150d027e: Confidential tokens go live: six mainnet Zama token pairs can now be shielded and unshielded, ZAMA staking appears for Ethereum wallets, and wrap/unwrap fixes and safety checks cover multisig wallets.
Wallet recovery widens: Safe wallet keycards can now recover funds on many chains, including Solana, Cardano and Stellar. XLM and HBAR recovery also supports external signers.
Stacks staking and Zcash get ready for upcoming changes: PoX-5 contracts and early exits are supported, and Zcash wallets are prepped for the NU7 upgrade expected around 5 Nov 2026.
New asset support: ZAR Universal on ARC and XRP, Grass on Solana for Go Accounts, and Canton Broadridge delegation and settlement flows.
Safer signing and fewer SDK errors: Stellar transaction explanations show more account changes before signing, and fixes cover SDK message-signing crashes and Express hanging on failed sends.
